  "Id" INTEGER -- PRIMARY KEY
  "DisplayName" TEXT
  "Reputation" INTEGER
  "WebsiteUrl" TEXT

  "AboutMe" TEXT
  "Age" INTEGER
  "ProfileImageUrl" TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE "posts" (
  "Id" INTEGER -- PRIMARY KEY
  "PostTypeId" INTEGER

  "CreaionDate" DATETIME

  "OwnerUserId" INTEGER -- REFERENCES "UserDetails"("Id")

  "CommunityOwnedDate" DATETIME
